items.name: Automated Decision-Making Technology (ADMT) Rights
items.description: Where ADMT substantially replaces human decision-making in a significant decision (e.g., automated underwriting, pricing, claims), provide a pre-use notice, an opt-out, access to information about the logic and outcome, and an appeal path. Crosswalk to GDPR Art. 22 and the EU AI Act.

items.name: Business Applicability & GLBA-Exemption Analysis
items.description: Determine whether Meridian is a 'business' under any threshold, and analyze which personal information is exempt as GLBA-covered versus in-scope. The GLBA exemption is information-level, not entity-level, so non-GLBA PI (web visitors, prospects, marketing, employees/applicants, B2B contacts) remains subject to the CCPA.
